create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
set_and_get_graph_weights: set and get graph arc weights as a Python list, NumPy array, or raw pointer
create_scalar_graph_for_autograd: create a scalar graph from a single weight value for use with autograd operations
run_backward_pass_on_graph_operations: run backward pass on graph operations like add, subtract, or negate to compute gradients
compare_and_persist_graphs: compare graphs for equality or isomorphism and save or load them to and from disk
